title.en: An Act Providing for the Purchase, Out of the Funds Appropriated for the Bureau of Education By Act Numbered Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Two, of Additional Land for the Industrial School Reservation At Baguio.

text.en:
The funds appropriated by Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and ninety-two for the Bureau of
Education are hereby made available in an amount not to exceed one thousand pesos for the purchase of in the
city of Baguio, subprovince of Benguet, Mountain Province.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, December 8, 1910.
